title: t27c on netlink.t27 -- a node fences before its peers decide
desc: t27c 0.5.0 and zig 0.16.0 on a Mac (macOS, arm64), spec at t27 c6237a7: all 9 tests pass, none vacuous; fencing at the 20 s TTL instead of 15 s makes exactly one test fail, a_node_stops_before_any_peer_can_see_it_down; git restores the spec.
commands: perl -pi -e 's/seconds_since_renewed >= SELF_FENCE_SECONDS/seconds_since_renewed >= NODE_TTL_SECONDS/' specs/queen/netlink.t27 && git diff -U0 | tail -n 2
